info.title: EasyReasy.Database.Testing.PruneTool
info.description: Dotnet tool that reclaims the per-checkout test databases (and optional scratch directories) of git checkouts that no longer exist, using the ownership markers EasyReasy.Database.Testing.Npgsql stamps. Lists by default; drops only with --yes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: prune-test-databases — reclaim the per-checkout test database and scratch tree of a gone checkout.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Test harnesses using EasyReasy.Database.Testing.Npgsql derive a database per checkout and stamp it
with an ownership marker recording the checkout path. Deleting a worktree leaves its database (and
any scratch directory) behind; this reclaims both. Nothing is dropped unless BOTH hold:
1. the name has the exact derived shape — the prefix followed by 8 lowercase hex characters;
2. the database carries the ownership marker, and the checkout path it records no longer exists.

options.name: --scratch-root
options.description: Root of per-checkout scratch directories; repeatable

options.name: --scratch-marker-file
options.description: Marker file name inside a scratch tree                    (default: checkout)

options.name: --yes
options.description: Perform the drops instead of only listing them
